content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Candidates should possess an Undergraduate Degree in Life Sciences, Environmental Sciences, Ecology, Forestry, Wildlife, Public Policy, or similar / allied fields. Candidates should possess basic typing skills in both Tamil and English. Minimum 1 year of relevant work experience will be given priority. Candidates having 1 years of relevant experience, preferably in a Government Department / Government Office, are preferred. Experience in Data Entry and Data Management. Experience in official file maintenance, record keeping and documentation. Proficiency in MS Word, MS Excel and MS PowerPoint. Ability to prepare official reports, letters, statements and PowerPoint presentations. Experience in data compilation, tabulation and office documentation. Good communication, coordination and organisational skills. Ability to coordinate with Government Departments and stakeholders. The DCCM guidelines specifically provide priority to candidates having at least one year of work experience. The candidate must be a resident of KanchipuramDistrict. The candidate should not have exceeded 40 years of age while applying for the post.

content_sections.heading: District Climate Change Mission Technical Assistant Job Description
content_sections.text: Coordinate DCCM activities with Government Departments and stakeholders. Assist in implementation and monitoring of climate change and environmental activities. Organise and support capacity-building programmes. Collect, compile and maintain climate and environmental data. Prepare reports, official correspondence, statements, presentations and documentation. Maintain official files, records and Mission-related documents. Assist in conducting DCCM meetings, workshops, training and awareness programmes. Document successful climate initiatives and district-level best practices. Undertake field visits related to District Climate Change Mission activities. Perform any other duties assigned by the Mission Director / District Climate Officer. These responsibilities are aligned with the Technical Assistant role specified in the DCCM guidelines.

faq.question: Q1. What is the position being recruited for under the District Climate Change Mission?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for Technical Assistant (1 No.) on a Contract Basis under the District Climate Change Mission, Kanchipuram.

faq.question: Q2. What is the consolidated remuneration for the Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: The consolidated remuneration is ₹22,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit applications?
faq.answer: The last date for submission is 31OCTOBER 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the duration of the engagement?
faq.answer: The period of engagement is 19 months, as per Government sanction.

faq.question: Q5. What educational qualification is required?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess an Undergraduate Degree in Life Sciences, Environmental Sciences, Ecology, Forestry, Wildlife, Public Policy, or similar / allied fields, and basic typing skills in both Tamil and English.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit and residency condition for applicants?
faq.answer: The candidate must be a resident of KanchipuramDistrict and should not have exceeded 40 years of age while applying for the post.

faq.question: Q7. How can candidates submit their applications?
faq.answer: Interested and eligible candidates may send their updated Resume/CV along with educational qualification and experience details to [email protected], [email protected] or submit them at District Forest Office Kanchipuram.

faq.question: Q8. What stages are included in the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process includes scrutiny of applications, an in-person interview, and a typing test, and a waiting list of 2–3 candidates may be maintained as per the DCCM guidelines.
